contact_layout.proof: At each port let d be cable outward direction, w point from pin1 to pin8, and n be outward PCB normal. For both identical bottom-contact connectors d cross w = -n. A continuous cable runs outward at endA but inward at endB. Keeping the same material copper side at both ends forces the conductor-index axis to align with w at A and -w at B, reversing connector numbering. A same-side cable therefore gives n to 9-n independent of rigid PCB placement; final path must still realize this orientation without damage.
